death.cause_text: You bled to death. Teeth close on your forearm and tear.
last_turns: You shoulder the back door and the alley opens up, grey and wet.
Something moves behind the dumpster. It is already on you.
The pressure on the arm goes loose, and then everything does.
truth_reveal: In the Rear alley: one of the dead.
You never saw it: Mara Voss: Bar the back door — "keep them out, whatever it costs"
willis: The noise. You went outside to see what the noise was. In this world. I laughed out loud.
Yeah, this is going to be neat. Hold still. Well, you can't not, can you—
voice: You want to know why. Everyone does. I have built this place every way it can be built, every stone of it, since before the atoms had names, and I got sick of watching it stand. So now I push. Once, at the right place, and I watch it go. The most fun game of dominoes there ever was.

Day 211, 21:40: you chose to leave the stockroom, thinking "I'll be quick." Day 212, 03:12: something scraped behind the dumpster. You noticed it. You did nothing. Do you know how much effort it takes to keep a runner in one alley for two days? Mara knows. She was the bait. I didn't have to touch you once. I gave you a revolver and Mara. And still.

Did you know something has been in that alley with you? For six hours. You never noticed. In about 30 seconds you are going to die. I won't tell you how. You should have paid more attention. Like I did.
And that is how. Teeth, the forearm, the dark. Every piece had a cause. Every piece was mine. Until my next game, when there's none of you left.
